name: Herb Search — Traditional Preparation toggle expands and collapses

planSteps.description: Type 'chamomile' into the search input and click 'Consult the Archive'
On the first herb card that has a 'Traditional Preparation' button, click it
That card now shows an expanded preparation text block and the button text changed to 'Hide preparation'
The preparation text block is hidden and the button text is 'Traditional Preparation' again
